acquisition method: the top 20 most intense peptides were isolated and fragmented
cleavage agent: 1 μg of trypsin (Sus scrofa) was added and digestion was carried overnight at 37°C
collision energy: fragmented by low energy CID, 35% collision energy
instrument: An LTQ OrbitrapVelos (Thermo Fisher) was used for performing liquid Chromatography
ionization type: The eluate was applied to the nanospray source of the Orbitrap spectrometer
labeling: the top 20 most intense peptides were isolated and fragmented
reduction reagent: Samples of isolated vesicles (rexPy) were reduced with 10 mM DTT (Dithiothreitol)
